question: Should OpenClaw core sponsor per-agent backup/restore/clone now, and if so should clones carry credentials and historical session transcripts by default?
rationale: The requested CLI would rewrite config and persisted agent/auth/session state, and current policy/docs do not define whether per-agent archives are portable, private, or clone-safe.

options.title: Design core per-agent restore
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a maintainer-authored or maintainer-sponsored design covering manifest schema, credential policy, transcript safety, rollback, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Fold into broader backup work
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13616 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44111 the canonical backup/restore direction and explicitly add per-agent clone semantics there.

options.title: Decline core clone for now
options.body: Close this only after a maintainer decides per-agent clone should remain a documented manual/admin workflow or external tool rather than first-party core behavior.

recommendation.title: Design core per-agent restore
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a maintainer-authored or maintainer-sponsored design covering manifest schema, credential policy, transcript safety, rollback, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current backup CLI surface and the open encrypted snapshot PR, so they are the closest available owner for the backup/restore direction question.
